causes.title: A slice's gNB has no N2 connection to the AMF
actions: Check the gNB's AMF address and port (ran/gnb-<slice>.yaml, amfConfigs: 10.53.0.5:38412).
The gNBs are supervised and retry (ran/gnb-entrypoint.sh): docker logs o5gs-gnb-<slice> shows each attempt.
If this came with a deploy, scripts/open5gs/deploy.sh rolls back on the gate failure.

causes.title: Radio-link failures: UEs registered but without a data path

evidence.detail: the core still counts every session: the loss is below the core

actions: Each affected UE is restarted by the UE supervisor within ~30 s (ran/ue-entrypoint.sh); if many are left broken, re-attach: scripts/open5gs/start_ues.sh.
Find what stopped the gNB heartbeats (2 s, UERANSIM): a FIFO cell dropping signalling, a starved UE container, or wall-clock steps; cell-congestion and cpu-saturation findings say which.

causes.title: UEs fail to register or attach
actions: Look at the AMF's reasons: docker logs o5gs-amf | grep -E 'reject|failure'.
Check every NF is registered at the NRF (docker logs o5gs-nrf | grep 'NF registered').
Expected for a few minutes after a Docker engine restart; UEs recover on retry (gate advisory).
